The late-delivery rate increased from 2.96% to 4.56% in 2017-03, despite a slight decrease in average delivery time. This suggests a potential issue with delivery reliability or order fulfillment processes during this period.

## Findings
- Late-delivery rate increased by 1.6 percentage points.
- Orders increased by 902, which may have impacted delivery performance.
- Overdue undelivered orders increased slightly from 65 to 71.
- Average promised delivery window decreased by 7.1 days.
- Cancellation rate decreased by 1.1 percentage points.
- Average order value slightly decreased from R$165.19 to R$163.59.

- Check if there were any changes in delivery logistics or carrier performance during 2017-03.
- Analyze the performance of sellers with the highest late-delivery rates in 2017-03.
- Investigate if specific product categories or regions showed a disproportionate increase in late deliveries.
